bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Unclean shutdown detected. The browser profile cache and cookie stores were not closed correctly and are flagged for recovery. To prevent data loss, writes are temporarily paused and restored tabs may load stale data. Run consistency checks and resynchronize the cache, then relaunch the browser.
